walkthrough.title: Finding where the paths to `7` and `8` split, by asking each subtree what it found.

steps.text: We're looking for 7 and 8. Start at the root and ask each subtree whether it holds either of them.
Go left to 5, then to 6. Nothing is below 6, so it reports nothing.
Under 2, the left child is 7, one of the two we want, so it reports 7. The right child 4 reports nothing.
2 heard from one side only, so it passes 7 up. 5 does the same.
On the right, 1 hears nothing from 0 and finds 8, so it passes 8 up.
3 hears 7 from the left and 8 from the right. This is where the two paths split, so the answer is 3.
